questions.questionText:
A light source is placed on one side of a growing plant.
What is the correct explanation of the role of auxin in shoot growth?

options.text: Auxin is equally distributed in response to light and stimulates cell elongation.
Auxin is equally distributed in response to light and inhibits cell elongation.
Auxin is unequally distributed in response to light and stimulates cell elongation.

options.text: Antibiotics are produced by white blood cells.
Antibiotics can become resistant to bacteria.

questions.questionText: Which statement about pollination in plants is correct?

options.text: Cross-pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther of a flower to the style of the same flower.
Cross-pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther of a flower to the stigma of a flower on a different plant of the same species.
Self-pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther of a flower to the filament of the same flower.
Self-pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther of a flower to the stigma of a flower on a different plant.
